# A second USD rate in CAD on 2026-01-02, the day
# prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt already prices, with a different value
# and no guid.
#
# GnuCash keeps one price a day for a commodity in a currency, so this is
# refused, listing the price already there.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the refusal.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_second_price_on_one_day_is_refused.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-02 18:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.37"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"
